summary: Iteration 3 PASS for 'maps without Google API key'. Seeded test_token_agent location via POST /api/locations (correct Convex path; the task's suggested /api/tracking/location returns 404). Owner web (test_token_owner): tab-more → sub-tab 'تتبع GPS' renders iframe data-testid='agents-map' with srcdoc containing leaflet.css/js and tile sources basemaps.cartocdn.com + server.arcgisonline.com (Esri), NO maps.googleapis / maps.google.com/embed. Clicking agent-location card opens agent-map-sheet with iframe agent-live-map; map-type-m/k/h pills all present and switch tiles (streets→Esri satellite→hybrid). agent-map-mode-trail shows iframe trail-map with seeded point. 'فتح في تطبيق الخرائط' button (data-testid='agent-map-open-google') present with correct Arabic text and uses mapOpenUrl plain google.com/maps/search deep link (no API key). /agents-map screen loads and renders AgentsMap. Field agent (test_token_agent) tab-ops renders ops screen cleanly without route-map (no stops have coords — correct no-crash behaviour). ZERO network requests to maps.googleapis.com or maps.google.com/embed captured across full flow. No console errors from removed react-native-maps; grep confirms no 'react-native-maps' or 'GoogleMapEmbed' import anywhere under /app/frontend/src or /app/frontend/app. OBSERVATION (not a regression): CARTO Voyager streets tiles are served from basemaps.cartocdn.com without an API key and therefore render with a diagonal 'API KEY REQUIRED' watermark overlay — the map still works, but visually suggests a key is required. Esri satellite layer is clean (no watermark). Consider switching the streets layer to a watermark-free free-tier provider (tile.openstreetmap.org, OpenFreeMap, or Stadia Alidade with free dev key) to match the user's spirit of 'no API key'.

issues: CARTO Voyager anonymous tiles (basemaps.cartocdn.com) render with a diagonal 'API KEY REQUIRED' watermark across every streets map (owner tracking map and agent live map in map-type-m). Tiles still load, but the watermark is visible to end users. Reference: /app/frontend/src/maps.ts:37 (trailHtml streets layer) and /app/frontend/src/maps.ts:64 (leafletHtml streets layer).

action_items: Replace the CARTO Voyager tile URL in src/maps.ts (both trailHtml and leafletHtml streets layers) with a watermark-free provider — e.g. https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png (OSM standard, respect usage policy with a proper User-Agent referrer), or OpenFreeMap (https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty/... with MapLibre) or Stadia AlidadeSmooth with free dev key. Current CARTO anonymous tiles stamp 'API KEY REQUIRED' on the map which contradicts the 'no API key' goal visually.
critical_code_review_comments: src/maps.ts leafletHtml inlines large HTML/JS as a template string per render; consider memoising at component level or caching by stringified markers to avoid rebuilding the srcDoc on every parent re-render (iframe reloads whenever the html string identity changes because of key={html}).

LeafletMap.web.tsx forces iframe remount on every html change via key={html}; combined with the one-minute refetch in AgentMapSheet (LIVE_MS=60000), the live map fully reloads tiles every minute, causing visible flicker. Consider imperative Leaflet updates via postMessage instead of srcDoc remount.

mapOpenUrl / mapDirectionsUrl in src/maps.ts still produce google.com/maps/search?api=1 and google.com/maps/dir?api=1 URLs — these are plain web links (no key) and only used by the external 'فتح في تطبيق الخرائط' / 'الاتجاهات' Linking.openURL buttons, so the 'no Google Maps API' goal is still satisfied; just worth noting these open Google Maps on the device as before.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core flows (owner tracking map, agent live map, map-type pills, trail map, open-in-maps button, /agents-map screen, agent ops no-crash, zero Google Maps requests)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct Convex endpoint for seeding location is POST /api/locations {lat,lng,accuracy?} — NOT /api/tracking/location (returns 404). AgentsMap only renders in owner tab-more → sub-tab 'تتبع GPS' (segment text selector); the AgentLocationRow card has testID='agent-location-<user_id>' (open-map-<user_id> is the icon button).
